Strap into EXOcars and compete against real players in single-player races and real-time multiplayer. Exciting driving feedback, advanced physics and graphics make for an unparalleled VR buggy racing experience. 

![{"height":550,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39035368_1862644587819825_3080998053427261440_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=1gK6YkfSIPQQ7kNvgHUqJGe&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBtlmkt2Ua7-flnvHhF0OWjnBAtN04ANg1VT6991j-TaQ&oe=6756B570)

**SPEED AND SPECTACLE**

From streets and stadiums to deserts, mountains and a tropical paradise - Track design in EXOcars pays close attention to landscape, surface type, and terrain relief.

Featuring ramps, drifts, and natural obstacles, it makes you feel like a driver of a roaring buggy car, speeding through stunning scenery!

![{"height":550,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75495673_1231181821248354_2079948616970460648_n.png?_nc_cat=109&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=CS_jt8F4gnoQ7kNvgGtKVKY&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAAme05LVeFhpzPSTcZG41qFB3_wDCI9HRb8XzhegHQeA&oe=6756D8F2)

**ADVANCED GRAPHICS AND PHYSICS**

EXOcars pushes hardware limits on both Meta Quest 2&3, offering high fidelity graphics and rock-solid framerate. 

The game is based on real car physics. Suspension dynamics and track surface interactions ensure an immersive driving experience.

![{"height":550,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974660_2733348826832225_4553388353214106215_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=3e1w6G5G9xkQ7kNvgEGVEu_&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBokdD3I2UrJq0KkEuDfC18o3PG4GwtiTHqK_-QxhsI8w&oe=6756BB1A)

**MAKE YOUR FRIENDS BITE THE DUST**

Each single-player race puts you against ghosts of real opponents matched to your skill level, allowing you to progress and become a top-notch pilot organically.

Real-time multiplayer lets you compete with friends. Or find new ones in social lobbies!

Whether you’re a casual driver or a seasoned champion, our matchmaking will suit your needs. 

![{"height":550,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974568_1462873904418216_3607017857187096802_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=2nc-OHwLHcMQ7kNvgGrUsXB&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBj6x38pDn2k5ZDNEHW3eetyjwL-thwuNKcR-jNiN-7bA&oe=6756D0D4)

**READY TO RELEASE THE BRAKE?** 

Carving through the wilderness or tearing up the asphalt, EXOcars promises an unparalleled experience that will keep you coming back for more. 

- Tournaments with real prizes
- Car customization
- New game modes
- Challenges and seasonal events 

**… and we’re just getting started!** 
![{"height":550,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974860_435555335606071_7680737174999049899_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=FWyzbowzSqwQ7kNvgEkj8ik&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD9DXe875QilnaNokrtbZwJF2dCAp9mq3pyXLw_MaSQgw&oe=6756BF51)
